access: PRIVATE: excluded from reserved reviewer until independent solutions are frozen.
method: Curriculum designer saved own complete source and controlled-account translations first. The independently prepared source-editor and coordinator witnesses were then read and compared against those saved translations. This comparison is separate from future task-key review.

findings.finding: All three identify Britain as initial hit, the stone as hine, an indicative general condition, jet/copper/iron/lead/silver, and snakes fleeing. Rich in veins of metal / productive in ores of metals is an idiomatic difference under the original note; no participant or clause relation differs.

The opening time-frame can be restructured idiomatically: after a long time they lift their gaze and see Æthelwald. From a distance / far off differ idiomatically; both must retain feorr and the subsequent seeing. Source-local temporal and periphrastic help governs translation, not a new tense system.

All three distinguish purpose (watch journey and see what happens), embedded question, and factual reason (storm noise). The modal wolde does not force a private-desire reading. Gode belongs to dear to God, not a different subject.

All three preserve prayer, calm, favorable winds, landing, ship carried up, storm return, and final inference. He remains the expressed calming subject; none silently replaces it with God. The source periphrases admit simple past under Cook’s notes.

Our Lord and Saviour Christ / our Lord Jesus Christ are transparent renderings of the title sequence; both preserve the nested Father-of relation. Life is morphologically singular; idiomatic English lives is acceptable and is not a source plural analysis.

All agree the calm was brief, granted from heaven at the holy man’s prayers for the sailors’ rescue. Given/granted is required, not forgiven. The exact numbered apparatus, rather than memory of a witness note number, controls the learner footnote.

The source editor independently interpreted all14 examples and the59-word account consistently. First food giver is explicitly the fisherman. Final Hē is contextually the son; grammatical masculine gender alone does not uniquely force that referent. Came back is a contextual English interpretation of cōm, not a newly taught lexical return sense.

future_review_boundary: This does not replace the reserved reviewer’s independent solutions to all92 tasks or subsequent key comparison.
